Frequently Asked Questions

How soon can I retake the IELTS? + −

With First Academy's training you will not need to retake tests! 😎 If you however want to retake the test, you can do that anytime. There is no waiting time between tests. As long you have test dates you can take it any number of times and at any time.

If you haven't yet been trained by us, here is your chance to experience an awesome session of the best IELTS training!

Attend a Free Session

What about the GRE? + −

The GRE is a different beast. You can take the test once every calendar month. There is also another limit. You cannot take the GRE more than 5 times in a calendar year.

If you need help with the GRE, you can always check out one session of the best GRE coaching for free!

Attend a Free Session

Will you help me register for the test? What do you charge? + −

Yes! We would love to help you register for the test. and we do not charge anything extra either. 🤩 Some tests however recommend the candidate register for the tests themselves.

GRE, TOEFL, and OET are three tests which work best if you create a profile all by yourselves. Once you create a profile we can then help you book the slot!

Can I get some free tests and material? + −

Yes! Our Blog and our Prep Site have several free tests, practice tests, sample responses, full length DET practice tests and more. You can also request for an evaluated practice test for more popular tests too.

If you have any specific requests, you can always place a request and we will see what we can do for you! Most requests are given serious consideration!

Free Resources 

Do you do personalised training/corporate training for other stuff too? + −

Absolutely! We have a large repertoire of skills. If there a particular training requirement related to English, Life Skills, Aptitude, Mathematics, Vocabulary or other related areas, we would love to work with you. Do contact us and we will reach out to you.
